code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low lymphocyte/neutrophil percentages, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or severe infection. Elevated creatinine indicates renal impairment. High ferritin, CRP, and INR suggest systemic inflammation and coagulopathy. Elevated alkaline phosphatase and basophils may indicate hepatic or hematologic involvement. Findings are concerning for severe systemic illness (e.g., sepsis, multi-organ dysfunction); urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
